title: kblog.py propose runs over the committed ops sidecars, so _logs.csv holds rows for the operator to confirm
goal: kblog.py propose has been run over the committed store for the window and events the operator chose, so kb/_self/_logs.csv holds proposed rows the operator can confirm one by one; a second run on the same store proposes nothing new. Split from ST-mbnahtlc in the 2026-10-05 backlog review: a dry run since 2026-09-01 would propose 6608 rows, mostly the retired fleet's land runs.

options: sprint.close and agent.run rows since 2026-10-04 (after the fleet)
every event of the last 7 days
